note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase / PSNProfiles trophy list). Guides are written in our own words for this entry; each cites its source.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops by itself. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup — and the platinum is the last sound you hear.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Finish the story (Stage 1).
Complete the 100% checklist (Stage 2).
Clean up the remaining trophies (Stage 3) — the platinum pops with the last one.

trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission — play it through to the end and the trophy pops when it finishes. Nothing to prepare; just start the story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start a new game.
Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Keep playing the story missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter ends. Do Lucia's balcony meditation before the chapter closes — see Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play the Chapter 1 missions in order.
Before the chapter ends, do the balcony meditation with Lucia (see trophy 28).

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Story trophy — it pops when the chapter ends. From Chapter 2 on you play as both characters, which opens the last meditation spot.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play the Chapter 2 missions in order.
The trophy pops at the end of the chapter.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Story trophy — it pops when the chapter ends. Take the optional stranger missions as they appear; some expire.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play the Chapter 3 missions in order.
The trophy pops at the end of the chapter.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Story trophy — it pops when the chapter ends. You are one chapter from the finale; save manually at the chapter's start and end, since missions cannot be replayed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play the Chapter 4 missions in order.
The trophy pops at the end of the chapter.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Finish the story — five chapters, roughly 60–80 hours — and this gold pops at the credits. Free-roam continues afterwards, so finishing loses you nothing.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Finish Chapter 4, then play the final mission.
The trophy pops at the credits; free-roam continues after.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. A story mission trophy — play the mission through and it pops at the end.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the story until Breakfast Run unlocks.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission trophy — play the heist through and it pops at the end.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist unlocks.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story mission trophy — play the mission through and it pops at the end.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the story until Child's Play unlocks.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story mission trophy — play the mission through and it pops at the end.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the story until Headliners unlocks.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission trophy — play the mission through and it pops at the end.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the story until VCIA Takedown unlocks.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission trophy — play the mission through and it pops at the end.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory unlocks.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion — the hardest trophy in the set and about 100 hours of Stage 2. After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion: the checklist wants every robbery (39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 bank vaults), 70 of the 80 challenges, all underwater discoveries, shooting-range golds, drone-race wins and Bret's quests. The checklist only appears after the story, but progress made during the story already counts toward it.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work the checklist: robberies, 70 of 80 challenges, discoveries, ranges, drone races, Bret's quests.
The gold pops when the checklist hits 100%.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses and airtime — they pile up fastest in a fast car off ramps and jumps around Leonida. Watch the count in Progress, then Stats, and grind the remainder after the story with a fast car and open road.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Drive fast and jump — stunts count as you play.
Check the count in Progress > Stats.
Grind the remainder after the story on ramps and jumps.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once. Sample one of each as they unlock during the story — the in-game Progress menu shows which types you have tried. One taste of each is enough; mastery is not required.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Open Progress to see which activity types you have tried.
Play one of each of the nine types.
The trophy pops after the ninth type.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the ranges and gold each challenge — Combat Focus steadies your aim, and you can retry any single challenge until it is gold. Work through them after the story; none of them is missable.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit a Shooting Range.
Gold all 42 challenges, retrying any that fall short.
Combat Focus helps steady aim for the gold times.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's gates on a practice run, then push for the win — one victory per location is enough. The locations are spread across Leonida, so this pairs well with exploration.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Find the Top Fun drone races (14 locations).
Win one race at each location.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter the race events around Leonida — street, off-road and circuit — and win 20 distinct ones. Repeats of the same race do not count, so keep entering new events.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Enter race events around Leonida.
Win 20 different races — new events only.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, then out-fish him: match the lure to the water, keep the tension steady, and land the bigger catch.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Find Cal's fishing challenge.
Out-fish him — steady tension, right lure.

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade cabinet through to its end — pick the shortest game on your first visit and see it through.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade cabinet.
Play one game through to the end.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is Lucia-only — follow his missions to the last one. Quest givers can go quiet for stretches of the story, but Andy returns, so keep checking.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Play as Lucia and follow Andy's missions.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's strand to its last mission. He is temporarily unavailable at points in the story, but every trophy-related quest giver comes back, so keep checking after each chapter.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Follow Kenton's missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Follow Billy's missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as pink-lettered icons — start each strand when it appears, because some expire (the hourglass ones), and finish 8 full strands. They are not part of the 100% checklist, so save them for Stage 3 if any are left.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Start stranger strands as their icons appear.
Finish 8 full strands — watch the hourglass timers.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Follow Randy's missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only — follow his missions to the last one.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Play as Jason and follow Tyrone's missions.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — and mind the one that can be missed. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning: she says she is going to meditate. Follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. That meditation may be required for the trophy and cannot be repeated after Chapter 1, so do it before the chapter ends. The last spot only opens once you play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
trophies.missable_note: Potentially missable — the only one in the set. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies: the full official list

steps: Chapter 1, after Down to Earth: Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — follow her to the balcony, choose Accept.
Meditate at the remaining spots across Leonida.
The last spot needs both characters, after Coffee Break (Chapter 2).

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand points you at specific animals — study the target with binoculars first to learn its habits, then take the shot. Bret's quests continue into the 100% checklist, so start the strand early.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Start Bret's hunting strand when it appears.
Study the unique animal with binoculars, then hunt it.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across the 5 counties — 3 cards per county count toward the exploration challenge — so pick up every card you pass and finish any 3 full sets. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so keep collecting after this pops.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies: the full official list
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Pick up collectible cards as you explore (3 per county).
Complete any 3 full sets.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app and scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures — 100 of them. Scan as you travel during the story; the app marks what you have scanned, so mop up the rest after the credits.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Open the WAiNK app and scan landmarks as you travel.
Reach 100 scanned locations.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. The game has 80 challenges in 8 groups of 10, tracked in the Progress menu from the start — complete any 50. Many finish naturally while you chase other trophies, and 100% needs 70, so this pops on the way there.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies: the full official list

steps: Check Progress for the 80 challenges (8 groups of 10).
Complete any 50 — many finish while chasing other trophies.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it clears. Quiet back roads and water help you vanish.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Bring your partner along.
Build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight until it clears.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner, rob three shops in a row — keep the wanted level alive between robberies and don't get caught. Plan the route first: three close shops make it manageable.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Bring your partner; pick three close shops.
Rob all three in a row, keeping the wanted level.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app as you find them — parked, driven or in traffic. 200 vehicles are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way to the platinum.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app as you find them.
Reach 100 discovered vehicles.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a firefight with a cluster of enemies and drop 5 before it ends. Pick a fight with cover and grouped enemies — a gang hideout works well.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a group of enemies.
Trigger Combat Focus and drop 5 before it ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, take a plane without a scheduled flight — get airborne from the airport on your own terms and leave the runway behind.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to Vice City International Airport.
Take a plane and get airborne — no scheduled flight.

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Get into a Rhino tank — steal one when the military rolls in at a high wanted level — and put it to work. The tank itself is the point: drive it, don't just look at it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Raise a high wanted level until Rhinos roll in.
Steal a Rhino tank and drive it.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards, and leave without raising the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — the trophy only counts a clean run.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Pick a jewelry store and go in quiet.
Avoid cameras and guards; leave undetected.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults are part of the robbery set — 8 vault robberies count toward 100% — so hit 5 vaults and get clear each time. Plan the getaway before you go in.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Find bank vaults (8 count toward 100%).
Rob 5 vaults and escape each time.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck on the road, crack it open and get away before the police box you in. A quiet stretch of highway and a fast getaway car help.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Ambush an armored truck on the road.
Crack it open and escape.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit all 52 areas across the 5 counties — the map fills in as you travel, so check Progress to see which areas are still unvisited, then drive out to them. This pairs with the WAiNK scans and vehicle discovery.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Travel all 5 counties; the map fills in as you go.
Check Progress for unvisited areas, then visit all 52.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs — hit one illegal operation for each. Operations are marked as you discover them, and 39 Gang Operations count toward 100%, so this pops while you work the checklist.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Discover illegal operations around Leonida.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Order a cocktail at a bar on Ocean Beach and take in the view — a quiet moment, no combat needed. Any bar on the beachfront counts.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to a bar on Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail and enjoy the view.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom's frontage and out the other side — pick a showroom with a clear exit line and commit to it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Drive through it and smash your way out.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Vice City — follow through on every throw.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a full game.

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one is tied to a scripted partner moment in the story — keep playing the duo missions with your partner and it pops at the moment itself. There is nothing to grind; just don't skip the partner scenes.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Play the partner missions with your duo.
The trophy pops at the scripted partnership moment.

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). The game tracks your choices — dialogue and mission decisions — toward a count of 500. There is no single trigger; keep making choices across the playthrough and the count climbs until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (counts as PlayStation tracks them)

steps: Make story and world choices as you play.
The counter climbs toward 500; the trophy pops when it lands.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail, then succeed: retry something you just failed and complete it on the second attempt — a mission or activity retry is the natural trigger.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail a mission or activity.
Retry it and complete it on the second attempt.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness one of Leonida's strange encounters — the odd, unmarked events out in the world. Keep exploring side roads and remote spots; it pops when you stumble into one.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore side roads and remote spots.
The trophy pops when you witness a strange event.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. From a moving vehicle, knock someone down with a melee attack — a drive-by with a bat or similar weapon, not a gun. Slow down beside a pedestrian and swing.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive by slowly and knock someone down with the melee swing.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — launder them through your contacts a little at a time until $250,000 is clean. Bank and gang-operation loot feeds this, so it builds as you work the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies.
Launder them through contacts until $250,000 is clean.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and mods — spending anywhere counts, and it adds up fast late in the game when money is plentiful. Big purchases like vehicles help it along.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend across shops — clothes, weapons, food, mods.
Reach $100,000 total spent.

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 garages, each with one parking spot — the first is Mitchel Auto Center at $4,000. Buy them as you can afford them; they also store your vehicles, so they earn their keep.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Buy garages as you can afford them (8 in total).
Mitchel Auto Center ($4,000) is the cheapest first buy.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Steal or buy vehicles, then register them in the Scooter Bros app — any 10 count. It pairs naturally with discovering 100 vehicles for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Get vehicles — stolen or bought.
Register any 10 in the Scooter Bros app.
